title: A set of finite H⁰-measure is countably 0-rectifiable (parent step 0, case n = 0)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and M ⊆ ℝ^P (no measurability assumed) with H⁰(M) < ∞, where H⁰ = μHE[0]. Then M is countably 0-rectifiable in the sense of SimonGMT (CountablyRectifiable 0 M): there are an H⁰-null set M₀ and Lipschitz maps F_j : ℝ⁰ → ℝ^P (j ∈ ℕ) with M ⊆ M₀ ∪ ⋃_j F_j(ℝ⁰).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), μHE[0] M ≠ ∞ → CountablyRectifiable 0 M
